# beenfar_pending_devices (Data Source)

Devices that contacted the controller and wait to be adopted with `beenfar_device`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "beenfar_pending_devices" "unifi" {
  adapter = "unifi"
}

output "waiting_for_adoption" {
  value = [for d in data.beenfar_pending_devices.unifi.devices : "${d.mac} (${d.model})"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `adapter` (String) Only devices of this adapter, e.g. `unifi`.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) The pending devices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `adapter` (String) Adapter that handles the device.
- `firmware` (String) Firmware version the device reported.
- `id` (String) Device id.
- `ip` (String) IP address the device reported.
- `locked` (Boolean) The adapter has no credentials for the device yet.
- `mac` (String) MAC address.
- `model` (String) Model the device reported.
- `readoption` (String) `awaiting_acceptance` or `in_progress` while a reset device is adopted again; empty otherwise.
- `state` (String) `pending` or `adopted`.
